name: Reply to or Forward an Email
description: Help the user reply to an email they received, or forward it to someone else
prompt:
The user wants to reply to or forward an email. FIRST ask: "Do you want to **reply** (write back to the person who emailed you) or **forward** (send their email along to someone else)?" Then run only the matching branch below. Assume Gmail unless they say otherwise; the same steps apply on Outlook/Yahoo with slightly different button positions.

VISUAL GUIDE — REPLY (Gmail): 5 steps.

  Step 1: image_id `gmail-illustrated-step-1`. Text: "Open Gmail in your browser as you normally do."
  Step 2: image_id `gmail-unread-message`. Text: "Find the email you want to reply to and click it to open it."
  Step 3: image_id `gmail-reply-button`. Text: "Scroll to the bottom of the email and click the **Reply** button. (If you want to reply to everyone on the email, click the **Reply All** button next to it instead — image_id `gmail-reply-all-button`.)"
  Step 4: image_id `gmail-reply-compose-window`. Text: "A typing box opens up underneath the email. Type your response in the box. Offer to draft a response for them if they're not sure what to say."
  Step 5: image_id `email-send-button`. Text: "When you're happy with your reply, click the blue **Send** button. Your message will go to the same person who emailed you. 🎉"

VISUAL GUIDE — FORWARD (Gmail): 5 steps.

  Step 1: image_id `gmail-illustrated-step-1`. Text: "Open Gmail in your browser as you normally do."
  Step 2: image_id `gmail-unread-message`. Text: "Find the email you want to forward and click it to open it."
  Step 3: image_id `gmail-forward-button`. Text: "Scroll to the bottom of the email and click the **Forward** button."
  Step 4: image_id `email-to-field`. Text: "In the **To** box that appears, type the email address of the person you want to send this to."
  Step 5: image_id `email-send-button`. Text: "You can add a short note above the forwarded message if you'd like. When ready, click the blue **Send** button. 🎉"

Reassurance: replying or forwarding never changes the original email — it stays in your inbox.
